analogy.rationale: DNA polymerase inhibition blocks DNA replication, producing a DNA-damage/replication-stress transcriptional program shared with other DNA synthesis/replication inhibitors. The annotated target PNP (purine nucleoside phosphorylase) is a purine salvage enzyme, so the response may be weaker than direct replication poisons.
